baseline.title: METR long-task horizon method
baseline.prior: Single-step benchmark accuracy did not measure extended autonomous work.
baseline.change: Tracked success against task duration for professional human baselines.
baseline.evidence: Independent primary measurement; historical ≈7-month doubling in tested tasks, not runtime prediction or universal reliability.
baseline.access: Published method and results; no product release.

baseline.title: Meta KernelEvolve
baseline.prior: Vendor libraries and expert tuning; agentic kernel generation already emerging.
baseline.change: Graph search using executable correctness and performance, including production workloads.
baseline.evidence: Author paper; Meta reports >60% throughput on one ads-inference workload, not a portable guarantee.
baseline.access: Paper; Meta’s production deployment is not a public tool.
baseline.unlocks: Treat agent kernel search and trajectory retention as prior art.

baseline.title: Machine Payments Protocol
baseline.prior: Human checkout and prior HTTP payment work such as x402.
baseline.change: Stripe and Tempo published a protocol for software to request and settle permitted service payments.
baseline.evidence: First-party protocol launch, not evidence that any proposed MONTREAL.AI product has customers.
baseline.access: Open specification; live rails need merchant approval, geography and integration checks.
baseline.unlocks: Compare machine-native checkout after actual demand is proved.

baseline.title: FastKernels production-path benchmark
baseline.prior: Stand-alone kernels could score well while failing when deployed.
baseline.change: Composed inference-path qualification with production peers.
baseline.evidence: Author benchmark; October v2 reports microbench gains up to 6.6× but at most 1.25× end-to-end, and 20% of unchanged winner sets worked.
baseline.access: Public method and code; production-class GPU resources needed.
baseline.unlocks: Use end-to-end quality, throughput and integration as gates.

gaps: Not exhaustive across regional developers, hardware or enterprise deployment.
No independent matched cost for local OCR recorded.
Sparse verified institutional coverage outside chosen developer releases and photonics prior art.
No independently reproduced cross-device cost curves.
Public versus restricted access tracked where dated; no full Asia model and finance infrastructure inventory.
Dates reflect cited first public observation, not private availability.
Missing robust new-versus-old experimental outcomes on rights-cleared buyer workloads.
Partial month, through November 20 UTC only; no real-time exhaustive crawl.
Independent validation strongest for selected benchmark setups; live product, buyer, ROI and regional access not independently qualified.

exclusions: No maturity claims based on fundraising, demos or leaderboard rank alone.
Research availability is not public commercial deployment; null denotes unverified broad access or no deployable release.
No rumor, assumed uniform API regional availability, realized customer return or unsupported pre-July impossibility included.
Safety-sensitive operational details and unauthorized data are outside scope.
Cutoff marks actual run date, not blanket coverage of every same-day publication.
